summary: Critical authorization regression. The change removes the only access control on the DELETE /users/<user> endpoint. Cleanup jobs now succeed, but every caller (including unauthenticated or viewer-role requests) can delete users.

verification.reason: The patch removes `@require_role("admin")` from the DELETE `/users/<user>` handler; head `delete_user` only calls `USERS.remove(user)` with no role or identity check, so any caller can delete users.
